Gamma: Business Storytelling, Made Beautifully Simple | IVP

While modern business communication continues to shift across boardrooms, classrooms, keynote stages and small Zoom windows, presentations have endured as a core way that we communicate.

Of course, that endurance has not been without friction. Between conception and execution, every presentation begins with a daunting blank page, which results in a messy middle where ideas are lost in formatting purgatory. Hours disappear into Google Slides and Microsoft PowerPoint, struggling to get not only the content but the designs just right.

Teams are regularly wasting time and money buried in decks. What if you could construct your presentation with clarity and polish built in from the beginning? What if that time could instead be spent sourcing new customers or building new products, rather than moving margins by millimeters or swapping fonts?

Enter: [Gamma](https://gamma.app/?gad_campaignid=22945420719&gad_source=1&gbraid=0AAAAAqWjqPSgKxpqrU-L4gwV1f0hG8mBH&gclid=Cj0KCQiAo4TKBhDRARIsAGW29bcVOSxiojA78cLenPbE1o5LiHGmuC0xl4bcuEylUtrp8Z67xIOp_64aAv_AEALw_wcB&utm_campaign=22945420719&utm_content=184797578139&utm_id=tw&utm_medium=search&utm_source=google&utm_term=gamma+ai).

Co-founders [Grant](https://www.linkedin.com/in/grantslee/) (CEO), [James](https://www.linkedin.com/in/james-f-fox/) and [Jon](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonnoronha/) built Gamma to help teams communicate ideas clearly and powerfully, pulling users out of formatting purgatory and back into more meaningful work. The result is an AI-native platform that offers generative slide design (with world-class standards) in seconds or minutes rather than hours or days.

The team recently launched [Gamma 3.0](https://gamma.app/insights/introducing-gamma-3-0), as part of its effort to turn customer concepts into visually stunning content. With the new rollout, users have:

- **Gamma Agent:** An AI-powered assistant that can research anything, refine your points, transform images and edit content with precision via a natural language interface.
- **Gamma API:** Instantly generate meeting recaps from Zoom transcripts, create custom slide decks from CRM data, or translate lesson plans into 60+ languages – no manual work required.
- **Gamma for Teams:** Collaborate with real-time, multi-player editing, store brand-specific assets and themes and manage users and billing in one place

Gamma is the speedway to reinventing business communication.

We’re proud to partner with Grant, James, Jon and the full team as they make Gamma the default layer for professional storytelling.

As a partner to CEOs, I draw most on my time as a professional athlete and my experience in enterprise sales at Oracle and Cloudera. I started my career as a runner for Nike, competing on a global level for two years. As any athlete knows, professional or otherwise, every ounce of energy invested in preparation increases your competitive edge. If you’re targeted in training and tenacious enough to persevere, it translates on race day. In sport and in company-building, there’s no substitute for putting in the time and effort—no shortcut to success. 
 
In my role in venture, I think of being a partner to founders and execs in the same way that I think about being on a sports team: we all have one another’s best interests in mind, and we’re united through a shared understanding and a common goal. Both inside the walls of the firm and beyond them. 

I strive to go the extra mile for the companies I work with, leveraging my knowledge of enterprise sales to contribute in meaningful ways, whether by surfacing candidates for key roles, providing benchmarking and contextual data, making introductions or asking the right question at the right time.

From technology that enables cloud and data infrastructure to stacks emerging for AI or information security, I work with companies developing underlying infrastructures for autonomous and business applications and for consumer experiences. That means I get to live in the future every day, hearing founders talk about the reality they aspire to create and the gaping holes they see and seek to fill. Working together toward their vision and seeing it come to fruition is the sweetest victory of all.

There’s nothing quite as satisfying as sprinting toward an ambitious objective as a team. From my time in product to the work I do now at IVP, a critical part of my role has been identifying the highest-impact customer problems and partnering with those who feel an irrational compulsion to solve them.

Having worked across all the phases of a startup’s lifecycle, from pre-PMF to IPO, I strive to bring that context as I partner with the founders building the next generational companies. At Snowflake, I came to deeply appreciate the transformative power of applying step-function architectural improvements to universal workflows. My time at Confluent taught me that product and GTM are two sides of the same coin. And my experiences at early-stage startups left me with a deep appreciation for the process of finding product-market fit.

Across it all, I’ve internalized the mindset that opportunity comes down to having an open mind. Every meeting and interaction with founders is a chance to see the world from a different point of view and learn something new. It might sound simplistic or easy, but the willingness to listen, learn and believe is often the difference between spotting and missing the next big thing.

Startup founders are irrationally optimistic. They take on huge challenges, persist through rejection, and navigate extreme uncertainty. As an investor, joining them in that optimism and reaching the point of unwavering belief in their vision is nothing short of a thrill. The real fulfillment, though, comes from partnering deeply with founders through the inevitable highs and lows of turning that vision into reality.
